title: Seahawks rookie DT Deven Eastern back on active roster

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Seahawks rookie DT Deven Eastern back on active roster
sources.description: The Seahawks activated rookie defensive tackle Deven Eastern from the active/physically unable to perform list on Thursday after he passed a physical, the team announced.
